sites.architectural_control: The retained1911 plan controls the asymmetric hall footprints, courtyard openings, pool and14 gopuram positions. Granite hall fronts are modeled as recessed cores with exposed column ranks; rooftop slab patches and restrained finish variation distinguish broad covered halls without introducing unsupported domes or pitches.
sites.interpreted_detail: Column spacing and simplified relief, rooftop joints and weathering are authored interpretations, not exact measured pillar ranks or surveyed roof finish. The broad hall roof outlines are retained from the site plan.

sites.name: konark-sun-temple

The supplementary13-point production DEM survey establishes separate approximate ground datums: Mayadevi9.9468m, kitchen15.2816m, north elephants14.5822/15.7320m and south horses18.0655m. Each modeled group has an independent bounded feathered terrain pad; the runtime surface consumer applies that pad datum per vertex, so each group retains local y=0 feet without an additional datum offset. These are calibrated production terrain heights, not geodetic architectural survey measurements.

sites.architectural_control: INTACH site plan and jagamohana photographs identify three pidha roof groups, roofless Mayadevi southwest of the principal temple, excavated kitchen southeast, elephant sculptures north and horses south. IGNCA inventory OR/PRI-51 records Mayadevi existing dimensions 29.5 x18 x4.55m, east orientation and 0.90m pista. The wider41m platform comes from the production footprint, rather than extending the published29.5m shrine body dimension.
sites.interpreted_detail: Individual roof offsets, subsidiary cell wall thicknesses, sculptural niches and simplified animals are original interpretations of the primary plan and photos. Kitchen stump heights are interpreted remains, not surveyed elevations. Only footprints explicitly replaced by authored remains are suppressed; other archaeological and service buildings remain.

sites.name: sagrada-familia
sites.verified_features: As ofSeptember2026 Jesus exterior complete172.5m;14existing towers,4future Glory towers absent;135m evangelists and138m Mary. SourceOSM includes speculative185m values and is not architectural height authority.
sites.ground_note: Anchor includes the inverse rotation of the local Jesus tower center(0,11). Pad45.579m from12sidewalk perimeter samples.
sites.detail_limit: Small sculpture, carving and repeated facade ornament are original low-poly interpretations, not a photogrammetric replica. Numeric controls refer to massing, counts and placement; fine motifs are not metrically surveyed.
sites.architectural_control: Official central-tower booklet specifies parabolic form and12/14/8 paraboloid sides for Jesus/Mary/Evangelists. Jesus tower prefabricated panels start85m. Official Matthew account places open-rib lower Evangelist stages at45–74m, closed tower body74–112m and22.5m terminal; later official updates give9m wings. Mary terminal has6m crown,18m shaft and7.5m diameter star. The172.5m completed Jesus tower and current14-tower state follow the retained2026 foundation evidence.
sites.interpreted_detail: Tower sections use faceted parabolic taper with independently open lower Evangelist ribs, recessed panel apertures and stepped terminals. Exact panel perforation counts, construction-joint spacing and statuary forms remain authored interpretations. Footprint paving receives a bounded lower-only terrain cut.
sites.nave_and_glory_control: Official architecture article gives15m central nave width,45m vault and30m side vaults, double stone roof and diagonally laid Ulldecona stone. July2026 foundation update places the central roof crane base54m high. Lower side roof profile34m at the inner edge is an interpreted external clearance above30m vaults; it exposes the clerestory rather than occluding it behind a45m invented slope.2023 annual report confirms side-roof lantern construction. The2026 Glory booklet documents seven bronze doors (central5m x4.7m), and eight supporting columns below the future towers at roughly30m. March2025 update confirms those columns under construction. Column shaft/branch completion heights, windows and roof-lantern forms are interpreted construction detail; no completed Glory towers or future16-lantern narthex is authored.

physical_materials.method: Construction material is selected per site and named authored component palette, never through a global brightness classifier. Natural cliff and monolithic rock use ROCK4; terraces retain PAVED8. Recesses in unglazed stone temples are rough dark rock rather than reflective glazing.
